# TJpgDec

[TJpgDec](http://elm-chan.org/fsw/tjpgd/) R0.03 by ChaN - free software,
no restriction on use, see [LICENSE](LICENSE) (the notice at the top of
`tjpgd.c`).

`tjpgd.c` and `tjpgd.h` are the unmodified sources of `tjpgd3.zip`
(sha256 `052fe3efbc9a8be29f31597ad009c5b51a4f6905878eb28569e0ab3d46d0c013`).
`tjpgdcnf.h` is the configuration file of the package, set for dmimg_jpeg:
RGB888 output (`JD_FORMAT 0`), scaling on (`JD_USE_SCALE 1`), the 32-bit
decoder (`JD_FASTDECODE 1`).
